thesis_claim: Replace the image encoder and required neck adaptation while retaining the SAM2 prediction architecture; assess accuracy, complexity and practical efficiency.

shared_input.3d_scaling: one volume-wide 0.5th/99.5th percentile mapping, clipped to [0,1]
shared_input.constant_intensity: zero scaled image before ImageNet normalization

independent_2d.box: tight target box in canonical coordinates, persisted before model execution
independent_2d.primary_scoring: predicted target on the complete image
independent_2d.oxford_inference: standardized single-image/video-predictor pathway, explicitly labelled; no confidence-memory image flow

full_3d.axis: validated geometry/source order, frozen before execution
full_3d.support_count: min(P-1, max(1, ceil(0.25*P))) where P >= 2 target-positive slices
full_3d.support_selection: rank positive slice IDs by SHA256(protocol_id|case_id|seed|slice_id); take K and persist payloads
full_3d.schedule: offline: support frames once in physical order, then non-support frames once in physical order
full_3d.mask_support_policy: supplied annotation fixed identically across models
full_3d.primary_scoring: pool TP/FP/FN over all unprompted slices, including empty query slices
full_3d.P_less_than_2: ineligible for primary propagation task; report separately, never silently repurpose
full_3d.paired_manifest: derived from frozen positive-frame cohort; same eligible 3D targets and prompts

real_video.status: separate task design required; not silently pooled into 3D

2d_cross_image_flow.status: outside primary thesis scope; optional separately specified extension

positive_3d.unit: target-positive slice sequence from a held-out stored scan
positive_3d.selection: canonical target mask contains at least one foreground pixel
positive_3d.sequence_indices: dense over selected frames, retain stored slice ID mapping
positive_3d.supports: identical stored IDs and payloads in paired full_scan condition
positive_3d.primary_scoring: pooled counts over unprompted positive slices
positive_3d.training_alignment: positive-frame membership; not an exact training-window or augmentation replication

inference.initial_state_policy: all-frame GPU state retention, same across models; multi-support compatibility pending

metrics.hd95: secondary: independent 2D target or full 3D all-frame assisted surface distance; geometry/convention validation required

confidence_intervals.method: paired source-cluster bootstrap preserving frozen hierarchy

metrics.training_seed_replicates: one per variant unless additional completed runs become available

accuracy.launch_concurrency: headroom validated without disrupting Hiera training
accuracy.bf16: optional separate predeclared parity study only

prediction_archives.resume_and_report: verify archive identity, SHA256 and frame coverage

boundary_postpass.grid: stored annotation grid; nearest-neighbor binary mask reconstruction
boundary_postpass.scope_3d: full_scan only: all-frame assisted volumetric boundaries
boundary_postpass.units: mm only with explicit verified spacing; otherwise separate stored pixel/voxel groups
boundary_postpass.backend: google-deepmind/surface-distance; version and source hash recorded
boundary_postpass.scope_primary_3d: mean of real query-slice 2D surfaces; never concatenate gaps into a volume

efficiency.implementation_notes: docs/evaluation/performance-runner.md; no GPU jobs, tests, or preparation run
efficiency.cohort: metadata-selected eligible subset of accuracy manifest, drawn from staged pool
efficiency.sampling_status: proposal; final membership pending case/source eligibility
efficiency.2d_panel: up to 20 distinct source clusters per dataset/task; one image/target per source
efficiency.3d_panel: up to 5 sources per dataset/task/length bin; max one scan/target per source in main panel
efficiency.stress_panel: longest eligible available scan per dataset/task, separate from aggregate and deduplicated
efficiency.primary_interval: fresh-state full prediction, prepared host inputs to host predictions including state release; CUDA synchronized
efficiency.component_interval: complete image encoder including neck; GPU-resident inputs; CUDA events
efficiency.model_order: balanced and frozen before final trials
efficiency.repeat_counts_status: proposed; pilot then freeze before final measurements
efficiency.cross_machine_tolerance_status: justify and freeze before examining comparison results
efficiency.analytical_compute: declare MAC/FLOP convention and account for custom WKV operators; unknown ops are not zero
efficiency.training_speed: not established by this inference experiment

release_gates: canonical input and instantiated control parity
final checkpoint for each reported model
frozen timing panel and repeat schedule
positive-only encoder/memory membership and paired full-scan prompt parity
study_split_confirmation: User confirmed accuracy on A100 vs speed/memory on Gamma, each covering independent 2D and full 3D, on 2026-09-30.
